canonical_claim_ceiling: Architecture and simulation framework only; physical bulk-matter teleportation is not established.

epistemic_classes.grounded: Established mathematics, measurement practice, or experimentally supported physics within the declared scope.
epistemic_classes.modeling: Deterministic software architecture or mathematical representation that may be useful without claiming nature implements it.
epistemic_classes.speculative: Hypothesis requiring equations, predictions, falsifiers, and independent evidence.
epistemic_classes.unknown: Required information is absent or unresolved. Unknown never converts to pass.

transfer_modes.name: symbolic_state_transfer
transfer_modes.claim_ceiling: Structured state moved between software components.

transfer_modes.name: classical_information_reconstruction
transfer_modes.claim_ceiling: Classical information transmitted and used to reconstruct a declared representation.

transfer_modes.name: conventional_matter_relocation
transfer_modes.claim_ceiling: Matter physically transported by ordinary means; not teleportation.

transfer_modes.name: quantum_state_teleportation
transfer_modes.claim_ceiling: A quantum state is transferred using an entanglement-assisted protocol plus classical communication; bulk matter is not transported.

transfer_modes.name: scan_and_reconstruct_matter_model
transfer_modes.claim_ceiling: A software model of capture, encoding, destination resources, and reconstruction.

organs.name: source_intake_and_provenance
organs.purpose: Capture an external lead without silently strengthening or anonymizing its claims.
hard_gates: reported claim separated from AXM inference
tests: paraphrase does not exceed source claim

organs.name: claim_ceiling_classifier
organs.purpose: Assign observed, reported, inferred, modeled, speculative, disputed, or unknown status and cap public wording.
hard_gates: secondary source cannot create a primary fact

organs.name: unit_and_dimension_auditor
organs.purpose: Detect dimensional errors, unit-selected coincidences, hidden normalization, and unsupported significant figures.
tests: pi Mm/cs is not accepted as c
unit change cannot be treated as a new law

organs.name: known_physics_baseline
organs.purpose: Expose the established behavior a model must reproduce or explicitly depart from.
tests: null interval does not create photon rest frame
quantum teleportation remains distinct from matter transport
field drawing is not particle trajectory

organs.name: transfer_mode_classifier
organs.purpose: Prevent success in a lower transfer mode from being reported as a higher mode.
tests: quantum-state teleportation cannot claim matter relocation

organs.name: target_state_schema
organs.purpose: Define what is represented as the transferable target and what remains unknown.
hard_gates: visual description not treated as complete state

organs.name: measurement_uncertainty_envelope
organs.purpose: Track measurement error, missing observables, correlations, and uncertainty growth.
hard_gates: missing measurement is not estimated silently

organs.name: identity_and_continuity_contract
organs.purpose: Declare whether an output is continuing entity, reconstructed copy, approximation, visual match, or equivalence under a limited measurement set.
tests: duplicate is not silently called original

organs.name: invariant_register
organs.purpose: Register quantities and relations that must be preserved, transformed lawfully, or remain unresolved.

organs.name: transfer_space_registry
organs.purpose: Declare whether the modeled transition occurs in spacetime, a network, a state graph, phase space, Hilbert space, or a speculative manifold.
tests: mathematical space not called physical automatically
network path not called spacetime geodesic

organs.name: metric_cost_evaluator
organs.purpose: Evaluate distance, action, cost, risk, or validity under the declared transfer-space contract.

organs.name: path_or_transition_solver
organs.purpose: Find a valid path or transition sequence and report absence, multiplicity, sensitivity, and violated constraints.

organs.name: channel_and_carrier_model
organs.purpose: Declare what carries the transferable state and which coupling, resource, and measurement rules apply.
hard_gates: speculative carrier requires governing equation and falsifier
tests: entanglement alone cannot signal classically usable information
unknown carrier cannot validate MT-5 or MT-6

organs.name: causal_clock_and_ordering
organs.purpose: Track emission, transmission, interaction, reconstruction, comparison, and receipt ordering across declared clocks.
tests: departure and arrival remain distinct events
classical dependency cannot arrive before send

organs.name: destination_boundary_preparer
organs.purpose: Declare destination materials, energy, boundary conditions, clocks, contamination controls, and abort capacity.

organs.name: state_encoder_mapper
organs.purpose: Map the declared source-state representation into a channel-compatible representation with reversible or bounded-loss receipts.
tests: lossy map cannot claim exact state

organs.name: reconstruction_planner
organs.purpose: Plan a destination state preparation or reconstruction using declared resources and dependencies.

organs.name: fidelity_comparator
organs.purpose: Compare source and destination under a declared observable set and uncertainty model.
hard_gates: unmeasured fields excluded from equivalence claim

organs.name: conservation_and_causality_gate
organs.purpose: Apply invariant, resource, conservation, and causal checks before any success status is emitted.
hard_gates: resource ledger balanced within declared tolerance

organs.name: failure_containment_and_rollback
organs.purpose: Stop unsafe or invalid sequences, preserve receipts, and return the simulation or bench to a known state.

organs.name: prediction_and_falsification_engine
organs.purpose: Require a predeclared quantitative prediction and an observation capable of contradicting it.
tests: baseline-equivalent model cannot claim new prediction

organs.name: append_only_evidence_ledger
organs.purpose: Preserve inputs, versions, predictions, outputs, contradictions, failures, and reviewer dissent without silent rewrite.

organs.name: public_claim_labeler
organs.purpose: Generate user-facing wording that cannot exceed the claim ceiling and verification state.

organs.name: observer_visualization
organs.purpose: Render state, path, uncertainty, stability, reconstruction, and failure in an understandable visual or game layer without altering simulation truth.
tests: visual failure does not alter state

organs.name: matter_transfer_merge_gate
organs.purpose: Control promotion from hypothesis to model, model to validated simulation, and validated simulation toward experimental review.
tests: new evidence cannot silently rewrite prior result

deterministic_simulator.purpose: Model transfer states, paths, reconstruction, and failure without claiming physical realization.

observer_game_layer.purpose: Human-readable visual or game representation of a truth-labelled simulation.

promotion_requirements: claim wording no stronger than evidence
